spec_theorems.name: run_output_shape
spec_theorems.informal: The utility outputs exactly the adjacent-duplicate-collapsed input lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: Successful processing returns exit code zero.

spec_theorems.name: uniq_length_bound
spec_theorems.informal: The number of output lines is no greater than the number of input lines.

spec_theorems.name: uniq_content_preservation
spec_theorems.informal: Every output line is an occurrence of an input line.

spec_theorems.name: good_uniq_output
spec_theorems.informal: Adjacent lines in the output are distinct, so no repeated adjacent lines remain.

spec_theorems.name: uniq_idempotent
spec_theorems.informal: Applying adjacent-duplicate elimination to an already processed output leaves it unchanged.
